title: 🧹 Outskirt Sewer Rats Control
description: A plague of weak Outskirt Sewer Rats is chewing through the village food stores. Accept this quest to locate and defeat 3 Sewer Rats in the village outskirts. (Click an adjacent enemy or use a ranged spell/weapon to strike!)

title: 🪓 Blacksmith Alloy Supply
description: Deliver 3 Tempered Iron alloys (Iron Materials) to Grom Garison at the Oakhaven anvil. He needs them to temper weapons. (You start with some in your bag!)

title: 🚨 Raid on Westfold Farm
description: A cohort of 3 Bandit Raiders have camp-fire circles in the town plaza borders. Find and defeat them to secure Oakhaven limits!

title: 🧪 Apothecary Healing Wildflower
description: Gather and supply 3x Wild Berries to the Apothecary station to brew high-grade healing mixtures. (You can pick these from bushes, or use your starting supply!)

title: 💎 Royal Mithril Delivery
description: Supply 3x Glimmering Mithril alloys to Grom Garison to assist in forging high-renown vanguard heavy armor.

title: ⚖️ Sunder Outlaw Pardon Poorbox
description: Donate 200 Gold to the Church Poorbox to earn a royal pardon from Oakhaven Sunder. Clears Outlaw status and increases Town Reputation by +35!

title: 🍄 Wilderness Exotic Spores
description: Deliver 5x Wild Mushrooms to a Wilderness Herbalist to help brew restorative elixirs.

title: 🐺 Wilderness Thick Pelts
description: Deliver 3x Animal Hides (or Wolf Pelts) to a Wilderness Hunter resting in the wilderness.

title: ✨ Traveling Pilgrim Lost Relic
description: Deliver 1x Saint Sunder Amulet (or Gold Material) to a Traveling Pilgrim delivering sacred texts.
